item.title: Report: Over 80K migrants to be housed in ICE warehouses throughout US
item.description: With current ICE detentions at an all-time high, the Trump administration plans to open warehouses throughout the United States to house up to 80,000 detained migrants who are slated for deportation, according to reports Wednesday.

item.title: Trump's revival of Greenland takeover dismays Denmark
item.description: Trump, who has repeatedly expressed interest in acquiring Greenland for the U.S., angered officials by tapping Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry (R) as his envoy to Greenland.

item.title: US unemployment claims fall again last week, remain at historically healthy level
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The number of Americans applying for unemployment benefits fell last week and remain at historically healthy levels despite some signs that the labor market is weakening. U.S. applications for jobless claims for the week ending Dec. 20 fell by 10,000 to 214,000 from the previous week’s 224,000, the Labor Department reported Wednesday. [...]

item.title: Five key details from latest Epstein document dump
item.description: The Department of Justice (DOJ) released its new cache of documents related to Jeffrey Epstein on Monday, which brought more attention to President Trump's association with the disgraced financier and what else authorities knew about other Epstein associates.

item.title: ALERT: Teen still missing in Dothan
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Dothan Police are searching for a missing teenager. Dothan Police say 16-year-old Daniella Cabanes was last seen by her family at their home in the 100 block of Callowhill Court at around midnight on Sunday, December 21. There has been no update from Dothan Police on Cabanes' whereabouts on Christmas Eve. [...]
